verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an identity-management SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no natural-language or conversational interface for administering Entra ID. The Microsoft Graph API is only a developer building block. The MCP server probe points to a Microsoft Learn training/docs endpoint, not to a way of operating Entra itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
